subject: general
question: A total profit of ₹25,300 is to be distributed amongst P, Q, and R such that P : Q = 9:7 and Q : R = 3:12 The share (in ₹) of R in the profit is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of shares **P : Q = 9 : 7** and **Q : R = 3 : 12** (or 1 : 4).

Combine ratios by making **Q** common: **P : Q : R = (9×3) : (7×3) : (7×12) = 27 : 21 : 84**.

Simplified ratio **P : Q : R = 9 : 7 : 28** (dividing by 3).

Total units = 9 + 7 + 28 = **44 units**.

Value of 44 units = &x20b9;25,300 ⇒ 1 unit = 25,300 ÷ 44 = **&x20b9;575**.

Share of **R** = 28 × 575 = **&x20b9;16,100**.

**∴ The correct answer is &x20b9;16,100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total Profit = &x20b9;25,300 | P : Q = 9 : 7 | Q : R = 3 : 12.

**Formulas:** Combined Ratio A:B:C calculation | Total Profit = Sum of individual shares.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac567fe16da2f0f34b80bbfe3973a82e4e0ce1d374610ac47862e811e697d0cf.png] 

⇒ To equalize Q, multiply (P:Q) by 3 and (Q:R) by 7.

⇒ P : Q = 27 : 21.

⇒ Q : R = 21 : 84.

⇒ P : Q : R = 27 : 21 : 84.

⇒ Share of R = [84 ÷ (27 + 21 + 84)] × 25,300.

⇒ Share of R = (84 ÷ 132) × 25,300 = (7 ÷ 11) × 25,300.

⇒ Share of R = 7 × 2,300 = 16,100.

**∴ The correct answer is &x20b9;16,100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Balancing

When combining two ratios (A:B and B:C), the common term B must be made equal by multiplying the ratios with appropriate constants.

Profit Distribution

In a partnership, if the time period is constant, the **profit is distributed** directly in the **ratio of investments** or the given share ratios.</p
